title: SARdine markup v2
description: W004 GeoJSON markup, schema version 2. Adds: observer enum (human|ai|insitu|model), confidence semantics P(label correct) — NEVER a training weight, class + collection-level declared vocabulary (sardine:classes / sardine:scheme), sardine:valid interval, adjudication object (reason REQUIRED when rejecting insitu/model labels), and the label-region kind (MultiPoint | Polygon | MultiPolygon — GeometryCollection excluded; sparse points consumed via masked loss; multipart polygons sampled area-weighted). v1 files import cleanly: all new fields optional; unknown-field pass-through unchanged. Legacy class-region (null-geometry, dB-feature-space) untouched.

sardine:classes.description: Declared class vocabulary. Every label-region class MUST appear here (validator-enforced). Required whenever any label-region feature is present.

sardine:scheme.description: Vocabulary scheme for sardine:classes — lets the trainer decide whether two sessions' classes are poolable before pooling them.

anyOf.description: label-region: geometry restricted to MultiPoint | Polygon | MultiPolygon (GeometryCollection excluded — unbounded for the sampler)
all other kinds: geometry unconstrained (class-region legitimately has null geometry)

class.description: training class name (label-region); must appear in collection-level sardine:classes

confidence.description: P(label correct). Filtering/subsetting/reporting only — training reads class-conditional noise rates from calibration records, never this field. null = authoritative (human).

sardine:valid.description: Label validity interval; training pair admissible only if acquisition datetime falls inside.

reason.description: REQUIRED (validator-enforced) when rejecting an insitu or model label — a stronger claim than rejecting an AI proposal, must be attributable.

adjudication.description: Absent = not subject to adjudication. Rejected features SURVIVE export as hard negatives. Adjudication of insitu/model labels is allowed but tallies into estimator:'adjudication' calibration rows — never pooled with audit-derived rates.
